authority: Ryan authorized the weak-response experiment and evidence-driven bounded follow-through. This fixed CPU correction responds to diagnosed HOU motion-cost/speed errors and excessive weak-pool clutter; it starts no new training or model inference.

base_sequence.algorithm: Offline first-order maximum-score sequence with explicit missing state; all original choices revisable; no interpolated coordinates.
base_sequence.anchor_choices: All original >.3 candidates, not the original selected point. Each weak candidate must be reachable from a strong candidate before and after within the time horizon and speed bound. This is geometric evidence, not proof of ball identity.

diagnosis: 17 of 78 v1 strong HOU losses touch correct native edges above the 1.5 widths/second cutoff; largest correct edge is 2.143530296405197. HOU e03/e06 contribute 58 losses without that violation. Reference-assisted fixed path objectives support testing lower motion penalty separately from the speed bound; these diagnostics are not operational selector results.

data_usage.HOU: Prior completed label-assisted diagnosis is now explicitly used for fixed development parameter choice. This is not fresh validation; no further tuning inside this study.
data_usage.DET: Previously inspected development, excluded from fitting/checkpoint selection. All followup parameters locked before application; no DET reference seeds, parameter choice or training.
data_usage.selection_inputs: Only actual model candidate pools, native timestamps, source width and fixed parameters. No reference geometry, visibility, eligibility or outcome labels enter choose_sequence.

selection_rule: The main corrected research arm is motion_and_speed prospectively, regardless of rank. All four arms and all adverse effects are reported. This does not adopt a model or choose a production method.
threshold_selection_rule: Explicit HOU label-assisted development choice, revised before freeze or study selection: native plus >0.01 components preserve availability for all ten demonstrated e01 recoveries (native+.03 covers118/120 and loses frames200-201; native+.01 covers120/120). The .01 pool also excludes the exact twelve newly emitted e05 certain-hidden v1 choices because their component peaks are below.01. This does not guarantee zero hidden emissions: other .01 candidates remain. Every HOU episode retains a >=95% native-union availability ceiling. The earlier draft highest-threshold >=95% rule validly gave.03; this new recovery-preservation rationale explicitly replaces it before any run. No DET outcomes choose this threshold. Availability is not automatic selection accuracy.
followup_limit: Only the four declared arms. No full selector grid, unreported parameter search, label change or training. Subsequent changes need a concrete evidence-based decision.
known_adverse_threshold_evidence: Six real v1 e05 correct recoveries at frames14-19 have peaks below.01 and no nearby .01 component; this narrow arm knowingly removes those useful exact weak candidates. All adverse outcomes will be reported. No threshold extension or new candidate family is authorized in this study.
